The Summit is the longest-lasting insulation we have made. Its double-wall stainless steel construction keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12 — enough to carry you from a pre-dawn start through a full day out and back to camp. At 750 ml, it holds a meaningful amount without becoming a burden in the pack.

A few honest notes: the Summit is built for trail and camp use. It's not designed for technical climbing where every gram matters at the extreme end, and like any stainless bottle, a hard enough drop on sharp rock can dent it. Treat it well and it travels well.

If your trips are getting longer or the temperature swings are getting wider, the Summit is worth a look.
